jumping cow.name: Jumping Cow
rules: Hunting is restricted to dove, turkey, doe pronghorn, antlerless elk, antlerless white-tailed deer, and antlerless mule deer.

Hunting and fishing access is allowed by permit only. Hunters and anglers must have a proper and valid license for their activity prior to applying for a permit. Permit holders shall have their permit on their person at all times while on the property. Permits may designate specific geographic hunting zones; in this case permits are restricted to the listed zone and are not valid property-wide. Access permits for hunters and anglers will be issued free of charge. Permits may be obtained via a drawing process. Applications are available from the CPW in Denver (303)291-7227. Application due dates are as follows: 1. Dove, fall turkey, doe pronghorn, antlerless elk, antlerless white-tailed deer, and antlerless mule deer applications due the 3rd Monday in August. 2. Spring turkey applications due 3rd Monday in March. 3. Fishing applications due 14 days prior to intended access date.
Permitted hunters and anglers may take one other person (an observer) who is not hunting or fishing with them onto the property; however that person must remain with the permit holder at all times.
Permitted hunters other than those hunting dove and wild turkey may not enter the property prior to the first Monday after the opening day of their individual season.

Vehicular access to the property is restricted. Motor vehicle use is only allowed on marked existing roadways that lead to marked parking areas. All other access is restricted to foot and horseback only.
All gates on the property shall be left in the condition in which they are found after passing through the gateway.

Access is permitted from two hours prior to sunrise to one hour after sunset. In the event that an animal has been harvested by a hunter, the hunter may remain as long as is reasonable to recover and remove the animal from the property.
Camping is prohibited.
Fires are prohibited.

rules: Public access is prohibited between sunset and sunrise except for on the paved portion of the Riverfront trail and while fishing.
Overnight parking is prohibited.
Discharge of firearms or bows is prohibited, except while bowfishing.
Hunting is prohibited.
Dogs are allowed on the paved portion of the Riverfront Trail, but must be kept under control on a physical leash by the handler at all times.

watson lake.name: Watson Lake State Wildlife Area - Larimer County
rules: Public access is prohibited from one (1) hour after sunset to one (1) hour before sunrise, except while fishing.
Public access onto the fish passage structure located on the northeast side of Watson Lake State Wildlife Area is prohibited.
Public access is prohibited to the northwest side as posted to prevent access to the water outtake and fish disposal area.
Fishing from the walls of the fish passage or fishing in the fish passage is prohibited.
The use or possession of live minnows is prohibited.
Vehicle parking is prohibited on the South Dam.
Launching and take out of vessels is prohibited.
Hunting and discharge of firearms or bows is prohibited.
Ice fishing is prohibited.
Ice skating is prohibited.
Dogs are allowed but must be kept under control on a physical leash by the handler at all times, except as authorized in #900(C)(15).
verdict: Hunting and discharge of firearms or bows is prohibited.

waunita.name: Waunita Watchable Wildlife Area - Gunnison County
rules: Public access is allowed from April 1 through April 30 annually only, except during the second full week (Sunday through Sunday) of the month when public access is prohibited. Public access is prohibited at all other times.
Discharge of firearms or bows is prohibited.
Dogs are prohibited.
verdict: Everyone 16+ needs a hunting or fishing license or a State Wildlife Area pass; this area's own restrictions are below.

webster.name: Webster State Wildlife Area - Weld County
rules: Public access is prohibited, except from September 1 through the last day of spring turkey season.
Public access is allowed only for licensed hunters or members of a hunting party, and only on Saturdays, Sundays, Wednesdays and state and federal holidays.
Public access is prohibited from one (1) hour after sunset to 4:00 a.m.
Hunters may only access the property by parking in a designated, numbered parking spot inside the parking lot. Parking along the access road or Weld Co Rd 394 is prohibited.
Discharge of firearms or bows is prohibited, except while hunting.
Hunting with centerfire rifles and muzzleloaders is prohibited.
Hunting is prohibited in the inflow or outflow canals.
Horse use is prohibited.
verdict: Everyone 16+ needs a hunting or fishing license or a State Wildlife Area pass; this area's own restrictions are below.

wellington.name: Wellington State Wildlife Area - Larimer and Weld Counties
rules: Public access is prohibited on the Wellington and Schware Units from March 15 through July 15.

Public access is prohibited on the Wellington Unit from the first day of the regular waterfowl season to the first day of the pheasant season, except on Saturday, Sundays, Wednesday and state and federal holidays.
Hunting with centerfire rifles is prohibited.
Target practice is prohibited, except when authorized by the area wildlife manager.
Vessel use is prohibited, except for launching and use of vessels that are propelled by hand and used for waterfowl hunting, dog training or field trials.
Field trials may be authorized on the Wellington and Schware units during February, March 1 through 14, and August only. Field trials may be authorized on the Cobb Lake Unit year-round.
Game birds listed in #009(B) of these regulations may be released on the Cobb Lake Unit by the Division or its agent for educational or training purposes without seasonal or numerical restrictions.

Domestic birds, feral birds, or privately-owned game birds may be released year-round for dog training on the Cobb Lake Unit by permit only, in accordance with the provisions of this chapter and other applicable regulations, including, but not limited to, #007, #008, #009, #801 and #804 of these regulations. All such birds taken during training activities shall be removed from the State Wildlife Area by the dog training permittee and all privately-owned game birds shall be prepared for human consumption.
Horse use is prohibited, except at the Cobb Lake Unit, where horses may be used during field trials.
The Division is authorized to implement a dog training reservation system should overcrowding become an issue on the State Wildlife Area.
verdict: Public access is prohibited on the Wellington and Schware Units from March 15 through July 15. This area has its own reservation, permit or check-in rules; read them below. A hunting license or SWA pass is required.

west lake.name: West Lake State Wildlife Area - Larimer County
rules: Vessel use is prohibited, except for launching and use of vessels that are propelled by hand, wind or electric motor.
Public access to West Lake State Wildlife Area is exempt from requirements set forth in section #900(C)1 of these regulations.
verdict: Everyone 16+ needs a hunting or fishing license or a State Wildlife Area pass; this area's own restrictions are below.

west rifle creek.name: West Rifle Creek State Wildlife Area - Garfield County
rules: Public access is prohibited on the designated shooting range between sunset and sunrise.
Discharge of firearms or bows is prohibited, except while hunting or on the designated shooting range.
Camping is allowed by licensed hunters during an established big game season plus three (3) days before and three (3) days after each season.
Fires are allowed within a containment structure while camping.
verdict: Everyone 16+ needs a hunting or fishing license or a State Wildlife Area pass; this area's own restrictions are below.

whitehorse.name: Whitehorse State Wildlife Area - Adams County
rules: Public access is limited to youth and mentors who have received certification to use the property as participants in the youth hunting program.
Public access is limited to dates specified by the program.
Parking and access is allowed from designated parking areas only.

Reservations are available to authorized participants for waterfowl hunting. Reservations must be made in accordance with #901.A of these regulations. Hunters with reservations may only hunt the area specified on the reservation, except when hunting areas which are unreserved and unoccupied.
Waterfowl hunters must check-in and check-out at the designated check station and the reservation holder must be present while hunting.

williams creek reservoir.name: Williams Creek Reservoir State Wildlife Area - Hinsdale County
rules: Launching and use of all vessels is allowed.
Operating a vessel in a manner that creates a whitewater wake is prohibited.
Discharge of firearms or bows is prohibited, except while hunting.
Snowmobiles are allowed only as an aid in ice fishing.
Dogs are allowed but must be kept under control on a physical leash by the handler at all times, except as authorized in #900(C)(15).
verdict: Everyone 16+ needs a hunting or fishing license or a State Wildlife Area pass; this area's own restrictions are below.

willow creek.name: Willow Creek State Wildlife Area (Fishing and Hunting Lease) - Yuma County
rules: Public access is prohibited from June 1 through August 31.
Public access is prohibited from 9:00 p.m. – 4:00 a.m.
Dog training is prohibited.
Horse use is prohibited.

willow creek reservoir.name: Willow Creek Reservoir State Wildlife Area (Fishing/Hunting Lease) - Grand County
rules: Public access is prohibited, except while fishing, small game, and waterfowl hunting.
Public access is allowed only through designated access points as posted.
Hunting with centerfire rifles prohibited.

wind in the willows.name: Wind in the Willows State Wildlife Area - Hinsdale County
rules: Public access to the Easement Area is allowed from a single point located at the southerly end of the property, just north of the bridge on Hinsdale Co Rd 33, near the intersection of Hinsdale Co Rd 33 and Hinsdale Co Rd 30. Public access to the Easement Area from any other portion of the property is prohibited.
Public access is prohibited, except while fly fishing only.
Public access is prohibited from one (1) hour after sunset to one (1) hour before sunrise.
Public access is allowed by foot only.
Fishing access is allowed only on the Lake Fork of the Gunnison River, including twenty (20) feet on either side of the riverbank.
Dogs are prohibited.

windy gap.name: Windy Gap Watchable Wildlife Area - Grand County
rules: Public access is prohibited outside of the viewing area.
Public access is prohibited from sunset to sunrise.

Fishing is prohibited.

woods lake.name: Woods Lake State Wildlife Area - San Miguel County
rules: Vessel use is prohibited, except for launching and use of vessels that are propelled by hand, wind or electric motor.
Dogs are allowed but must be kept under control on a physical leash by the handler at all times, except as authorized in #900(C)(15).

yampa river.name: Yampa River State Wildlife Area - Routt County
rules: Discharge of firearms or bows is prohibited, except while hunting.
Launch or take out of vessels, except those being actively used for fishing, hunting or wildlife viewing is prohibited.
verdict: Everyone 16+ needs a hunting or fishing license or a State Wildlife Area pass; this area's own restrictions are below.

yarmony ranch.name: Yarmony Ranch State Wildlife Area (Hunting and Fishing Easement) - Jackson County
rules: Public access is prohibited, except while hunting or fishing.
Hunting is allowed for elk, moose and pronghorn with a limited public access permit only.
Limited public access permits may be obtained by contacting the CPW Steamboat Springs Service Center at 970-870-3333.
To obtain a limited public access permit, hunters must already possess a big game license for one of the specific hunt codes permitted on the property.
Limited access permits will be valid starting the 1st day of the season of the license.
Hunters may only access the property during the dates specified on their limited public access permit and may be accompanied by up to two (2) people who are not hunting.

Public access by hunters with a limited public access permit is prohibited prior to two (2) hours before sunrise and after one (1) hour following sunset, except that when an animal has been harvested, the successful hunter and their non-hunter companion shall be allowed to remain as long as necessary to remove it.
Fishing is prohibited during established big game hunting seasons.
Parking and public access is allowed from designated parking areas only.
Public access is allowed by foot and horseback only.
Discharge of firearms or bows is prohibited in the designated safety zones, or as posted.
Discharge of firearms or bows is prohibited, except while hunting.
Building blinds is prohibited.
verdict: This area has its own reservation, permit or check-in rules; read them below. A hunting license or SWA pass is required.

res901A: On all Division properties which have reservations available or required, those reservations may be made by phone or online (cpw.state.co.us).
Reservations for small game and waterfowl hunting may not be made more than 14 days in advance of the hunt date, nor after 12:00 noon on the day before the hunt date.
Reservations for big game hunting may not be made more than 45 days in advance of the start of the season for which the reservation is being made.
Unless otherwise specified, reservations for big game hunting are valid throughout the season designated by the license.
Hunters who wish to cancel a reservation must do so no later than 12:00 noon on the day before the hunt date.
Failure to hunt a reserved area without prior cancellation, or follow check station procedures, may cause forfeiture of the privilege to make reservations for the remainder of the hunting season.
Hunters are limited to a maximum of one reservation per hunt date.
Hunters must possess a valid license for the species to be hunted in order to make a reservation.
The individual named on the reservation must be at the property on the day of the hunt.
Hunters with reservations may only hunt the hunt area specified on the reservation.
Any exceptions to the above restrictions will be listed under property specific regulations.
